mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal is fresh orange segments, a whole fruit source of carbohydrates with fiber and water that generally has a lower glycemic effect than fruit juice. For someone with diabetes, whole oranges are typically a more moderate option for blood sugar levels than juice; portion control and pairing with protein or nuts can further reduce glycemic impact.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: Several wedges of fresh orange served plain on a plate.
